definitions.explanation: Being completely focused on something to the exclusion of all else.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{夢中|むちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{夢中|むちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{砂場|すなば}→砂場：06326_sunaba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were completely absorbed in playing in the sandbox.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: My daughter is crazy about idols lately and watches videos every day.

notes:
Literally means "in a dream" (⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧ = dream, ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ = inside).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become absorbed in ~)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (to be crazy about ~)
- {夢中|むちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ frantically/absently)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう} (absorbed in games)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう} (absorbed in work)
- ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう} (crazy in love)

USAGE:
{夢中|むちゅう} can imply being so focused that one loses awareness of surroundings or time, similar to being in a trance or dreamlike state.
